infographic.title: From %LEL Reading to Action
infographic.alt: Infographic showing how a gas detector measures percent LEL and raises a first and second alarm
steps: A catalytic or infrared sensor measures flammable gas as a percentage of its LEL.
0 to 100 percent LEL is sent as a 4 to 20 mA signal.
A common first alarm is 10 percent LEL: warn people and start ventilation.
A second alarm, often 20 percent LEL, triggers shutdown, isolation or evacuation.
